CustomField.description: Total one-time charge for this line, net of line Discount. Formula: UnitPrice * Quantity * (1 - Discount) for NRC lines; $0 for non-NRC lines. (Discount is a Percent field, so in formula context it is the fraction: 100% = 1, 50% = 0.5.) Used by Quote.Total_NRC__c roll-up.
CustomField.label: Total NRC (Line)
